verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit per-end-user identification via `x-pd-external-user-id`, per-user connected accounts, encrypted credential storage, proxy calls made with 'the connected user's credentials attached', and user-level revocation — directly matching the platform-engineer's need to isolate each user's agent to only that user's credentials. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of isolation guarantees and more detail on token scoping granularity beyond app-level connections.
